verdict.rationale: Community reports confirm a Box desktop sync client on both macOS/OS X and Windows. However, the same reports call it clunky, note a rigid 'Default Sync Folder' concept, and describe 100% CPU spikes on OS X with many small files, which undercuts the 'just works' part of the story. No first-party docs cover the desktop clients, and nothing mentions selective sync or on-demand files. Missing for 10: first-party desktop client documentation, evidence of selective sync, evidence of on-demand (online-only) files, current hands-on reliability corroboration.
